examples.text: The meeting has been moved to Thursday.

translations.de: Das Meeting wurde auf Donnerstag verschoben.
translations.es: La reunión se ha aplazado al jueves.
translations.fr: La réunion a été reportée à jeudi.
translations.it: La riunione è stata spostata a giovedì.

attribution.author: Former U.S. President Richard M. Nixon, officially a work of the U.S. government

examples.text: She earns more than her husband.

translations.pl: Ona zarabia więcej niż jej mąż.
translations.uk: Вона заробляє більше за свого чоловіка.
translations.de: Sie verdient mehr als ihr Mann.
translations.es: Ella gana más que su marido.
translations.fr: Elle gagne plus que son mari.
translations.it: Lei guadagna più di suo marito.

attribution.author: EU-OSHA, the European Agency for Safety and Health
